headline: Approved $8,000 My School Bucks lunch payment contract, shared use of maintenance facility at 135 Asa Pond Road, and consent agenda items.
summary: The committee approved a one-year My School Bucks contract, cutting the annual fee from $11,380 to $8,000 and restoring credit card lunch payments. It also approved a Town agreement for shared use of the school maintenance facility at 135 Asa Pond Road. Discussion without a vote covered new high school construction and possible student parking shortages for 2027-2028.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda 6-0, including the 9/22/2026 open session minutes, purchase orders over $10,350, homeschool requests, and PTO fundraisers.
Approved the field trip for the SKHS CTE Studio Art class to the Norman Rockwell Museum and Red Lion Inn in Stockbridge, MA, 6-0.
Approved the memorandum of agreement with the Town of South Kingstown for shared use of the School Maintenance Facility at 135 Asa Pond Road, 6-0.
Approved the contract award for professional athletic trainer services for secondary education students, 6-0.
Approved the My School Bucks contract for school lunch payments, 6-0.
